title: Pure Metalmorph
summary: Pure Metalmorph modernized tribute-trap control build, supported by Dragon Link consistency staples. Centered around Max Metalmorph and Incoming Machine!, the deck reveals bosses from hand or summons Metal Illusionist to Set archetype Traps directly from the Deck, tributing Level 5 or higher monsters on the opponent's turn into immune, disruption-heavy Machine bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Metal Illusionist Sets a Metalmorph Trap directly from the Deck upon Normal or Special Summon, can modulate its Level by 4 during the opponent's turn to become Level 5, and declares any Type to satisfy Max Metalmorph.
Incoming Machine! adds any monster mentioning Max Metalmorph or any Metalmorph Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand.
Black Metal Dragon links into Striker Dragon to search Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon, Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon, or Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon.
One for One Special Summons Level 1 Metal Illusionist straight from your Deck.

Zoa the Fiendish Beast can be Normal Summoned without Tributing if your opponent controls a monster, and can reveal a Max Metalmorph card in hand to Special Summon itself and Set a Metalmorph Trap from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Black Metal Dragon
steps: Normal Summon Black Metal Dragon and Link Summon Striker Dragon.
Black Metal Dragon triggers in the GY to search Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon from your Deck.
Banish Striker Dragon to Special Summon Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon from your hand.
Activate Darkness Metal Dragon's effect to revive Black Metal Dragon from your GY.
Link Black Metal Dragon and Darkness Metal Dragon into Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres.
Black Metal Dragon triggers a second time to search Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon.
Reveal Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon in hand to shuffle it into the Deck and Set Max Metalmorph directly to the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon is a 3400 ATK boss summoned off Max Metalmorph; it negates the activation of any opponent card or effect as a Quick Effect and burns for its original ATK.
Metalzoa X destroys a face-up monster on the field whenever the opponent activates a Spell or monster effect, and shuffles opponent cards into the Deck.
Metalflame Swordsman gains 300 ATK and inflicts 500 damage each time the opponent activates a card or effect, and can destroy an opponent's monster during battle.

Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres Tributes a monster you control to bounce a face-up card on the field without destroying, then Special Summons a Dragon like Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon from your Deck.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Max Metalmorph Tributes a Level 5 or higher monster on the field to Special Summon a monster mentioning Max Metalmorph from hand, Deck, or GY, equipping to it for a 400 ATK/DEF boost and destruction immunity.
Incoming Machine! searches any card mentioning Max Metalmorph or any Metalmorph Trap from Deck or GY.
Flame Coating Metalmorph Tributes a monster mentioning Max Metalmorph to Special Summon an enhanced Machine Metalmorph from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Time Engine revives a destroyed Level 5 or higher Machine monster, board-wipes weaker opponent monsters, and inflicts burn damage.

allow.Black Metal Dragon: Level 1 DARK Dragon that links into Striker Dragon to search Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon or Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon directly from your Deck!
allow.Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon: Level 10 DARK Dragon searched by Black Metal Dragon; banishes Striker Dragon to Special Summon itself and serves as a Level 5+ Dragon on the field for Max Metalmorph to Tribute into Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon!
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: discards 1 monster to Special Summon Level 1 Metal Illusionist directly from your Deck.
allow.Striker Dragon: Limited to 1 in TCG: Link-1 DARK Dragon summoned using Black Metal Dragon to trigger Black Metal Dragon's GY search for Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon!
allow.Dillingerous Dragon: Link-2 DARK Dragon that links from Striker Dragon and revives itself from the GY when a Rokket or DARK Dragon is Special Summoned.
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Link-2 Dragon made with Black Metal Dragon + Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon that bounces a card and summons a Dragon from the Deck.

main: Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon

Signature Level 8 DARK Machine boss (3400 ATK): reveals itself in your hand to Set 1 'Metalmorph' Trap directly from your Deck and shuffles itself back into the Deck; when Special Summoned by Max Metalmorph, negates the activation of ANY card or effect your opponent activates and burns them!
Metalzoa X

Signature Level 8 DARK Machine boss (3000 ATK): reveals itself in your hand to Set 1 'Metalmorph' Trap directly from your Deck and shuffles itself back into the Deck; when Special Summoned by Max Metalmorph, destroys 1 face-up monster on the field whenever your opponent activates a Spell or monster effect.
Zoa the Fiendish Beast

Level 7 DARK Fiend (2600 ATK): can be Normal Summoned without Tributing if your opponent controls a monster, and sets 1 'Metalmorph' Trap directly from your Deck while Special Summoning itself from hand.
Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon

Level 7 DARK Dragon (2400 ATK): Special Summoned from your hand by sending 1 face-up card in your Spell & Trap Zone to the GY, searches any 'Metalmorph' Trap when summoned, and lets you activate 1 Metalmorph Trap the turn it was Set!
Metalflame Swordsman

Level 6 FIRE Machine boss: reveals itself in your hand to add 1 card that mentions 'Max Metalmorph' from your Deck to your hand and shuffles itself into the Deck; gains 300 ATK and inflicts 500 damage each time your opponent activates a card or effect!
Metal Illusionist

Core Level 1 Spellcaster starter: Sets 1 'Metalmorph' Trap directly from your Deck when Normal or Special Summoned, increases its Level by 4 on the opponent's turn (to Level 5!), and declares ANY Monster Type for Max Metalmorph!
Incoming Machine!
Core Spell: adds any monster that mentions 'Max Metalmorph' or any 'Metalmorph' Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand!
Black Metal Dragon
Links into Striker Dragon to search Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon, Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon, or Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon directly from your Deck.
Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon

Max Metalmorph

Time Engine
